title: Canonical Chorizo
description: Remodels the pig to look more like the piglins.
body:
I've always thought the pig could use a remodel to make it look both more like the rest of the pig-based mobs in Minecraft and to make it more realistic.
This pack accomplishes both.  It gives it more realism while staying true to the design of the piglin.

Requires either EMF of Optifine to work.

Please enjoy!
